name: lachlan-00/musicbrainz
description: A PHP library for accessing the MusicBrainz API

scripts.qa: composer run-script syntax && composer run-script cs:check && composer run-script tests
scripts.syntax: ! find examples src tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P4 php -l | grep -v 'No syntax errors detected'

scripts-descriptions.coverage: Generates the code-coverage report into the build/coverage directory
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Performs code-style corrections on the whole codebase
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Performs a code-style dry-run on the whole codebase

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Allows you to use the GuzzleHttpAdapter. You must install one of the supported adapters.
suggest.rmccue/requests: Allows you to use the RequestsHttpAdapter. You must install one of the supported adapters.
